script.text: I really need your help. I've been trying to figure out how to say that without making this sound like a goodbye video. It isn't. But I am worried.
When I gained two thousand subscribers in two days, I kept checking my phone. Like... are these actual people? You found my stories. You wanted more. I was so happy.
And then everything went quiet. I kept uploading, but the views dropped. Lately, it feels like my videos barely reach anyone.
I don't know exactly why. That's the frustrating part. I finish a story, put it out there, and then start wondering what I did wrong.
Maybe the opening wasn't strong enough. Maybe the thumbnail wasn't clear. Maybe I just need more time. I keep turning it over in my head.
And now there's a deadline sitting in the middle of all that. I've got about four months before the monetization requirements change in February.

For new applicants, the watch-hour requirement for ad revenue is going from four thousand to eight thousand. The subscriber requirement stays at one thousand. But those watch hours... that's twice the climb.
I want this channel to become something I can keep building. And honestly, I'm scared I won't get there in time.
But calling the channel dead feels unfair to the people who are still here. Because you are here. I see your comments.
When you tell me you relate to a story, or leave something kind after an upload I was nervous about... I read that. It means more than you probably realize.
So, if you enjoy these stories, could you help them reach someone? Watch another one that interests you. Share one with a friend who might relate.
And tell me honestly what you'd like to see next. I want to get better at this. I don't want to sit here refreshing numbers and guessing.
I'm grateful for you. I really am. I'm just worried, and I didn't want to keep pretending I wasn't.
I still have stories I want to tell. I hope you'll be here for them.
